items.title: Quincy Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...with Fox Walker and Sonny Johnson – I had been told that a lot of this was because they had to have something that could match the volume. [INTERVIEWEE] That’s right.

ctx.x: If you say so – with Hampton made this so necessary, because with Fox Walker and Sonny Johnson – I had been told that a lot of this was because they had to have something that could match the volume.
